---
title: "Publications"
bibliography: publications.bib
csl: chicago-author-date-reverse-chrono.csl
nocite: |
  @*
---

<!-- This page renders every entry in publications.bib, cited or not, newest
     first. To add a paper, paste its BibTeX entry into publications.bib
     (from Zotero, or Google Scholar's "Cite" > "BibTeX") — nothing here
     needs editing. -->

::: {.scholar-link}
<i class="bi bi-mortarboard-fill"></i> 
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=bgYqODQAAAAJ&hl=en)
:::

<input type="search" id="pub-search" class="pub-search"
       placeholder="Search publications by title, author, journal, year…"
       aria-label="Search publications">

<p id="pub-search-count" class="pub-search-count"></p>

::: {#refs}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var input = document.getElementById("pub-search");
  var count = document.getElementById("pub-search-count");
  var container = document.getElementById("refs");
  if (!input || !container) return;
  var entries = Array.prototype.slice.call(container.querySelectorAll(".csl-entry"));

  function applyFilter() {
    var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var shown = 0;
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      var match = q === "" || entry.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
      entry.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
      if (match) shown++;
    });
    count.textContent = q === "" ? "" : shown + " of " + entries.length + " publications match";
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
});
</script>
